raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “status” in the question as referring to UNESCO designation of the Historic Centre rather than the ecclesiastical status of the nearby religious building (the Baptistery of San Giovanni), which is a minor basilica. This wrong framing at the outset drove subsequent searches toward UNESCO context and even an incorrect notion of “metropolitan cathedral” status, instead of confirming the Baptistery’s church status, leading the workflow down the wrong path.
